n83869.source: Plutarchus, Lucullus, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1914 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Lucianus, Podagra, ed. Karl Jacobitz, Leipzig 1913 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Nonnus, Dionysiaca, ed. W. H. D. Rouse, London 1940 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Polybius, Historiae, ed. Theodor Büttner-Wobst, Leipzig 1893 (Perseus)
lines: τὸ μὲν οὖν πρῶτον οἱ περὶ τὸν Φιλλίδαν οὐ προσεῖχον, ἀλλʼ ἔμενον, ὡς καταπληξόμενοι τοὺς ἐν τῇ πόλει·

n83869.source: Dionysius Halicarnassensis, Antiquitates Romanae, ed. Karl Jacoby, Leipzig 1885 (Perseus)
lines: οὐδέτεροι γὰρ ἐλπίσαντες μάχης δεήσειν σφίσιν, ἀλλὰ τῇ πρώτῃ ἐφόδῳ τοὺς πολεμίους ὑπολαβόντες φοβήσειν, Λατῖνοι μὲν τῷ πλήθει τῆς σφετέρας ἵππου πιστεύσαντες, ἧς οὐδὲ τὸ ῥόθιον ᾤοντο τοὺς Ῥωμαίους ἱππεῖς ἀνέξεσθαι, Ῥωμαῖοι δὲ τῷ τολμηρῶς·

n83869.source: Hymni Homerici, In Cererem, ed. Hugh G. Evelyn-White, London 1914 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Flavius Josephus, Antiquitates Judaicae, ed. Benedikt Niese, Berlin 1885 (Perseus)
lines: ὡς δὲ ἧκον, εὐθὺς μὲν Γλαφύρα δεσμώτην ἰδοῦσα τὸν Ἀλέξανδρον ἔπληξε τὴν κεφαλὴν καὶ καταπληξαμένη μέγα καὶ συμπαθὲς ἀνῴμωξεν.

n83869.source: Polybius, Historiae, ed. Theodor Büttner-Wobst, Leipzig 1893 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Demosthenes, De corona, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1903 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Philo Judaeus, De opificio mundi, ed. Leopold Cohn (First1K)

Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)
lines: Ἄδρηστε, ἐγώ σε συμφορῇ, πεπληγμένον ἀχάρι, τήν τοι οὐκ ὀνειδίζω, ἐκάθηρα καὶ οἰκίοισι ὑποδεξάμενος ἔχω, παρέχων πᾶσαν δαπάνην.

n83869.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Septuaginta, Machabaeorum iv, ed. Henry Barclay Swete, Cambridge 1905 (First1K)

n83869.source: Sophocles, Antigone, ed. Francis Storr, London 1912 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Lysias, De caede Eratosthenis, ed. W. R. M. Lamb, London 1930 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Demosthenes, Philippica 1, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1903 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Aristoteles et Corpus Aristotelicum, Ethica Nicomachea, ed. I. Bywater, Oxford 1894

n83869.source: Demosthenes, In Midiam, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1907 (Perseus)
lines: καὶ πάλιν γε τὸν ἄρχοντα, ταὐτὸ τοῦτο, ἐὰν μὲν ἐστεφανωμένον πατάξῃ τις ἢ κακῶς εἴπῃ, ἄτιμος, ἐὰν δʼ ἰδιώτην, ἰδίᾳ ὑπόδικος.

n83869.source: Demosthenes, In Midiam, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1907 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Demosthenes, In Midiam, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1907 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Demosthenes, In Midiam, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1907 (Perseus)

n83869.source: Homerus, Ilias, ed. David B. Monro and Thomas W. Allen, Oxford 1908 (Perseus)
